audit.why: Conceding level 1 to a 275-range triple dash and taking over at 2-3 with Avengerang matches the kit; the 58% win rate agrees.
audit.corrected: Read stands; the missing pieces were cooldowns and Wind Slash.

audit.whatIsWrong: None of her cooldowns appear, so 'punish the recovery' has no clock.
audit.why: Broken Wings is a flat 13s for the whole three-cast chain, Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7s, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s and Blade of the Exile 120/90/60s. Once she empties Broken Wings she is a 275-range melee with no gap-closer for thirteen seconds.
audit.corrected: An emptied Broken Wings is 13 seconds of a melee that cannot reach you — that is the window, and it does not shrink with rank.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wind Slash is never mentioned, so the page implies range alone keeps you safe after 6.
audit.why: Blade of the Exile grants bonus attack damage AND attack range, and lets her fire Wind Slash once — a ranged projectile finisher. Kiting to the edge of your own range does not put you outside hers while her ult is active, which is exactly how a poked Akshan dies after winning the lane.
audit.corrected: Her R adds attack range and a one-shot ranged Wind Slash, so 'stay at range' stops being safe while Blade of the Exile is up.

edits.before: Riven's bruiser stats and E shield outgrow your lethality — her W stun into Q3 knockup locks you out of Heroic Swing and her shield eats your burst before R can execute.
edits.after: Riven's bruiser stats and Valor's shield outgrow your lethality — and Blade of the Exile adds attack range plus a one-shot Wind Slash that reaches you where you thought you were safe.

edits.before: Land W (Ki Burst) stun or the Q3 knockup to lock you out of Heroic Swing and burst you inside her window
edits.after: Land Ki Burst's stun or the Q3 knockup to lock you out of Heroic Swing, then finish with Wind Slash

edits.before: Her E shield and three Q dashes let her survive Comeuppance, so 6 doesn't flip the lane — it's a skill window, not a free kill.
edits.after: Valor's shield and three Q dashes let her survive Comeuppance, and Wind Slash reaches you at range — 6 is a skill window, not a free kill.

edits.before: E is up constantly and your Q cooldown is low — you chunk her freely with Avengerang whenever she over-commits her dashes.
edits.after: E is up constantly and your Q cooldown is low — an emptied Broken Wings is 13 seconds where she simply cannot reach you.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your strongest pure-laning window — E is up often and your Q cooldown is low, so you punish her every time she dashes in and can't immediately stun. The rule is simple: her burst only lands if her W stun or Q3 knockup catches you, so force her to spend all three Q dashes reaching you, then E-swing through it and Avengerang her down. At 6 your R is a pick/execute, not a brawl tool — it does NOT win a straight 1v1 through her E shield and dashes, so save Comeuppance to finish her after she's low from poke or to punish a bad all-in, never to open one.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your strongest pure-laning window — E is up often and your Q cooldown is low, so you punish her every time she dashes in and can't immediately stun. The rule is simple: her burst only lands if Ki Burst or the Q3 knockup catches you, so force her to spend all three Broken Wings casts reaching you, then E-swing through it and Avengerang her down inside that flat 13-second reset. At 6 your R is a pick tool, not a brawl button — and once Blade of the Exile is up her extra attack range and Wind Slash mean backing off is no longer automatically safe.

notes: Wind Slash and the attack-range gain from Blade of the Exile were missing from every field; they are the reason a healthy-looking retreat after 6 still gets you killed. Broken Wings' cooldown is a flat 13s at all ranks, which makes the punish window unusually generous and worth stating.
